questionRef: 2020 HL Section L1 Q1–5 — complete section
questionText:
1. What do these people order to eat and drink? Give two details.

2. What luggage does this person have?

3. What is the weather like at the moment? Give two details.

4. Give two details about what this person wants to buy.

5(i). Give two details about the classes Tanya will attend in St Petersburg.

5(ii). What does Tanya plan to do in Russia after the two weeks of classes?
